children: UK packaging automation provider's H1 2026 revenue fell 2.3% yr/yr to £71.0 mln
Underlying profit before tax for H1 drops to £2.1 mln from £5.6 mln; Adjusted EPS drops to 5.7p from 14.0p
Company completed sale of Lambert business, improving liquidity with £16 mln proceeds after period end
Mpac says full-year outlook remains unchanged from June update
Company expects profit weighted to H2, with operational loading to increase
Mpac says impact of new 50% US tariffs on Canadian goods remains unclear
COMPETITIVE PRICING PRESSURE - Co said heightened price competition reduced gross profit margins in H1
CUSTOMER DECISION DELAYS - Co said delays in customer decision making impacted trading margins
RESILIENT SERVICE REVENUE - Service revenue grew 7.1% yr/yr and gross margins remained robust
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the industrial machinery & equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for MPAC Group PLC is GBp475.00, about 36.7% above its September 14 closing price of GBp347.50
The stock recently traded at 14 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 7 three months ago
